frozen_note: Frozen and hashed (rules_lock.json) BEFORE control links and landmarks are chosen. Never tuned against scored controls. Any later edit is a manifest deviation.

arm1.description: As-deployed: each source receives exactly the production *_raw call (build_search_query sentence; S2 = deployed three-strategy merge with the entity-name map), limit = parallel_fetch_limit. KG = ground_hypothesis_kg on the captured state's collect_pmids_from_state.

pubmed_direct_matched.description: Direct E-utilities client (ESearch relevance sort -> ESummary) run on the IDENTICAL Arm 1 sentence. Only this same-query pair may attribute a PubMed failure to the production client.

pubmed.entity_terms: the entity-name map value for each of the first max_entities supporting_entities that has a name, plus that entity's pinned synonyms (pinned hypothesis 'synonyms' map only; no live expansion), each quoted and tagged, OR-joined inside parentheses
pubmed.disease_terms: the pinned disease_context, quoted and tagged; omitted when empty
pubmed.fallback: when fewer than 1 entity has a name, the Arm 2 PubMed call is recorded not_run (no query can be built)

consensus.claim_normalization: strip whitespace and trailing punctuation; lowercase the first character unless the first word is an acronym (2+ leading uppercase letters)
consensus.disease_suffix: ' in ' + disease_context when disease_context is non-empty and not already contained (case-insensitive) in the claim; else ''

skip.s2: Arm 1 already runs the deployed three-strategy merge
